defence: No pooling gives the 51 districts with fewer than five bursts estimates driven by one or two counts; partial pooling borrows strength from the other districts in proportion to how little each one knows (τ = 0.56).
Because the districts are shrunk towards one rate dominated by the urban networks, the rural estimates keep only 16% of their true gap above that rate, which understates their risk.
In Lab 2.2 the districts are shrunk towards a rate predicted from their pipe material and age instead of towards one urban-dominated average.
